description: The closed vocabularies and fixed numbers every OpenReceive engine must share. This file is the ONLY hand-edited copy: npm run generate:models renders it into packages/js/core/src/generated/contracts.ts, packages/js/node/src/generated/swap-tables.ts, packages/ruby/openreceive/lib/openreceive/generated/tables.rb and packages/dotnet/BTCPayServer.Plugins.OpenReceive/Generated/OpenReceiveTables.cs, and npm run check:generated fails when any rendering is stale. Error codes and payment statuses are NOT here: they come from spec/schemas/error.schema.json and the OpenAPI document, which the same generator already reads. npm run validate cross-checks every enum below against the OpenAPI and JSON Schema copies, so the spec cannot disagree with itself.

nwc.encryption_modes_note: Preference order: the first mode the wallet advertises wins. No advertised list at all means the NIP-47 baseline nip04. Spelling aliases (nip44, nip_44, nip_04) are normalization, pinned by test-vectors/nwc-info.json, not vocabulary.

attempts.expiry_grace_seconds_note: Seconds past an attempt's expiry during which reconciliation still scans before closing it. test-vectors/attempt-reconciliation.json carries the same number and npm run validate asserts they agree.

swap.states_note: phase is the coarse bucket a UI branches on; terminal states stop provider polling and UI refresh. completed is deliberately NOT terminal: provider completion is not wallet settlement.
swap.attention_reasons_note: Every reason an engine may write into attention_reason. A reason without reserved:true must be produced by at least one case in test-vectors/swap-state.json (npm run validate enforces it). reserved:true names a reason the vocabulary holds for a transition no engine emits yet.

attention_reasons.meaning: The provider raised an emergency and chose to exchange rather than refund; funds may be in limbo.
The provider returned a status this engine does not know; do not guess a state.
The provider reported completed but the wallet never settled the invoice after a bounded wait. Reserved for a settlement poller; neither engine emits it today.
